leave_bereavement_days_007.answer: 3 days chargeable to sick leave; additional days may be granted upon Superintendent approval.
leave_bereavement_days_007.evidence: Teachers shall be allowed up to three (3) days of absence chargeable to sick leave for death in the immediate family or a permanent member of the household. Additional days may be allowed, chargeable to sick leave, upon approval of the Superintendent or his/her designee.

leave_bereavement_relatives_008.answer: Immediate family or a permanent member of the household. Immediate family includes: parent, step-parent, child, spouse, sister, brother, grandparent, grandchild, parent-in-law, sister-in-law, brother-in-law, son-in-law, daughter-in-law, aunt, uncle, nephew and niece.
leave_bereavement_relatives_008.evidence: Teachers shall be allowed up to three (3) days of absence chargeable to sick leave for death in the immediate family or a permanent member of the household. (Immediate family includes: parent, step-parent, child, spouse, sister, brother, grandparent, grandchild, parent-in-law, sister-in-law, brother-in-law, son-in-law, daughter-in-law, aunt, uncle, nephew and niece.)

leave_parental_paid_009.evidence: A teacher may use up to 30 days sick leave for absence due to the routine care and bonding with a newborn or newly adopted child.

leave_pregnancy_disability_010.evidence: A teacher may use sick leave for absence due to personal illness, injury, pregnancy, and exposure to contagious diseases...
